narr: A moist airmass was in place and contributed to flash flooding across the region during the afternoon hours.
ev: Street flooding occurred around Clinton and water accumulated in yards. Flooding occurred in the Kentwood subdivision where one to two feet of water was across roads. Water also entered a house on Neal Street.
Flash flooding occurred along Suncrest Drive.
Multiple streets were flooded in Pickens.
Flooding occurred with water near homes and in yards. Street flooding occurred in South Jackson.
Multiple roads were underwater. These included: Old Whitfield Road near Fire Academy Drive, Old Brandon Road near City Hall, S Pearson Road and Hwy 468 south of town near railroad tracks.
Streets were flooded in downtown Louisville.
